learning_objective: 🎯 Learn to save lives and care for others! Understand the basics of the healthcare system, the role of support staff, and essential first aid.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Healthcare isn't just about doctors. It includes nurses, paramedics, lab technicians, and General Duty Assistants (GDAs) who all work as a team to treat patients.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🤝 Role of a General Duty Assistant
main_concepts.simple_explanation: A GDA or nursing assistant helps patients with their daily needs (bathing, eating, moving), keeps their environment clean, and assists the nurses and doctors.
The four main vital signs show if a body is functioning properly: Body Temperature, Pulse Rate (heartbeats), Respiration Rate (breathing), and Blood Pressure.
Hospitals have many germs. Healthcare workers MUST wash their hands frequently, wear gloves and masks, and safely dispose of medical waste to stop infections from spreading.
The immediate care given to an injured person before the doctor arrives. Basic skills include cleaning a wound, applying a bandage, and handling fainting or minor burns.

fun_activity.title: 📈 Check the Pulse
fun_activity.instructions: Place your index and middle fingers on your wrist just below your thumb. Feel the beat? Count the beats for 60 seconds. A normal resting heart rate is between 60 to 100 beats per minute!

exam_tips: 📌 Memorize the four vital signs: Temperature, Pulse, Respiration, and Blood Pressure.
📌 Always emphasize 'Handwashing' as the number one way to prevent hospital infections.
📌 Empathy and patience are the most important psychological qualities for a healthcare worker.
quick_recap: ⭐ Normal human body temperature is around 37°C or 98.6°F.
⭐ First aid is temporary help, not a substitute for professional medical treatment.
⭐ A clean, quiet, and positive environment helps patients recover faster.
